name: Synchronous Drives & Inverters Private Limited
india_angle: The company emphasizes that its PMSM & BLDC Drives are 'Made in India with love.'
summary: Synchronous Drives & Inverters Private Limited specializes in the design and development of motor control solutions for electric vehicles, including EV motor controllers and motor control software. Their products support a wide range of DSPs and microcontrollers, indicating a focus on embedded systems within the automotive sector.
